faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: If your question is not here, call us and we will help.
faq.1.a: A dental implant is a small post placed in the jawbone to replace the root of a missing tooth. A crown is then fitted on top so it looks and works like a natural tooth.
faq.2.a: Dentists use local anesthesia so you should not feel pain during treatment. Some soreness afterward is normal and Dr. Mustak will explain how to manage it.
faq.3.q: How long does braces treatment take?
faq.3.a: It depends on your teeth and the type of braces. Dr. Mustak will examine you and give an estimate at your first visit.
faq.4.a: Cost depends on the treatment you need. Call us or message on WhatsApp and we will explain the cost after understanding your needs.
faq.5.a: Appointments are best because they save your time. Call 01716374977 or send us a WhatsApp message to book.
faq.6.a: We are at 59 Kazi Alauddin Rd, Bangshal, Dhaka 1100, beside Beauty Lacchi and Alom Khan Tea.

problems.heading: Problems We Treat
problems.intro: Tell us what you are feeling. We examine the cause and explain your options before any treatment.
problems.urgent: If you have severe pain, swelling, or bleeding that will not stop, call us now.
problems.toothache.title: Toothache
problems.toothache.text: Tooth pain can have many causes, such as cavities or infection. An examination finds the cause so the right treatment can be given.
problems.bleeding-gums.title: Bleeding Gums
problems.bleeding-gums.text: Bleeding gums can be a sign of gum disease. Professional cleaning and good home care often help.
problems.crooked-teeth.title: Crooked or Crowded Teeth
problems.crooked-teeth.text: Braces can move teeth into a better position and make cleaning easier.
problems.missing-teeth.title: Missing Teeth
problems.missing-teeth.text: Missing teeth can be replaced with implants, bridges, or other options, depending on your situation.
problems.sensitivity.title: Sensitive Teeth
problems.sensitivity.text: Sensitivity to hot or cold can have several causes. We check the cause and suggest treatment.
problems.bad-breath.title: Bad Breath
problems.bad-breath.text: Bad breath is often linked to plaque, gum problems, or cavities. A check-up and cleaning can help find and treat the cause.
